What they do

About Firehawk Ink

Firehawk Ink has been turning ideas into incredible works of art since 2013, specialising in hyper-realistic tattoos, striking UV designs and unique custom artwork. The team is friendly, professional and passionate about every piece they put down — big or small.

At Earthdance, their artists set up on site, ready to create something unforgettable with you. Whether you're after something bold, meaningful, mystical, or simply a beautiful piece of art to remember the weekend by, the Firehawk Ink Flash Book has a design worth finding. Come say hello, browse the book, meet the team.

The Earthdance flash special: a 5cm x 5cm tattoo for R650, picked from a limited run of festival-only designs — first come, first served. Memories fade. A Firehawk Ink tattoo doesn't.
